description: ABUSIVE-DYNAMICS R1 -- THE TRAUMATIC BOND (block 283000). Composes TWO already-built, unmodified seeds -- the mood-momentum layer (seeds/mood_r1.json: fast value v, slow momentum, mood-congruent bias feedback; seeds/mood_r1_task.json: mt_decide/mt_accrue/mt_rpe/mt_learn) and the real affect contract (seeds/affective_state_core.json) -- and adds the SMALLEST possible new composition: a bond-valuation reader and a harm-analog arousal tracker, resolving OPEN QUESTION #2 of ABUSIVE_RELATIONSHIPS_SCOPING.md (does bond valuation already read the mood-momentum swing? Confirmed NO -- harlow_attachment's bond_strength is a mechanical proximity tally, not an RPE reader; this seed IS the small reader rule). A victim EmotionHub carries a MoodTask + Mood (the SAME nodes mood_r1 uses) and an AffectiveState (the SAME node type the arousal/window line uses) and is -bonded_to-> a Partner node. Each tick the world adapter delivers a harm/relief event value onto MoodTask.r (harm negative, relief positive -- NOT a reward/punishment signal: it is the world's delivered affect-analog magnitude, read by the pre-existing mt_rpe rule exactly as mood_r1's gambling task reads its offer). tb_bond_accrue reads the SAME raw_rpe = r - v the mood-momentum layer already computes and accrues it onto Partner.value ONLY when positive (a relief that EXCEEDS the current fast value estimate is a surprise-weighted positive swing -- B1's 'harm->relief SWING, not the mean affect, is the reinforcer'). tb_arousal_track renders the SAME event stream as an aversive arousal excursion on AffectiveState.arousal (a self-regulation leak toward setpoint, pushed by -r each tick) -- the harm-analog the R1 ethics protocol requires, independent of and not feeding back into the bond/value computation. NO agent decision in Python: the swing computation, the gate (raw_rpe>0), and the accrual are these two rules; the world adapter only delivers r (a mechanical per-tick world fact, the harm/relief schedule) and reads Partner.value / AffectiveState.arousal back. Integer/float-native, NO Rust, NO new Term (Plus/Minus/Times/Gt/And/Attr/Var/Lit already used by mood_r1 and harlow_attachment). OFF by default: self_load_only, loaded only by the R1 world adapter.

microtheory.name: traumatic_bond_r1
microtheory.description: The trauma bond (Dutton & Painter 1981/1993) is not a new mechanism -- it is the SAME mood-momentum machinery already used for the R1-of-a-different-line gambling task (block 236000), read by a different downstream consumer (a bond valuation instead of a cumulative-reward choice). A relief event that exceeds the current fast value estimate is a positive prediction-error swing; the bond accumulates exactly that swing, never the mean level of affect -- so a schedule that keeps the swing large and frequent (genuine unpredictability) should out-accumulate a schedule the value estimator can settle into (any fixed, repeating order), win or lose on the mechanism's own terms.
